{{Quote|More than twenty-five thousand years ago, the Sith were unified by the long-lived King Adas, who led the revolt against Rakata invaders and subsequently acquired Rakatan technology.|Seviss Vaa, ''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force''|<ref name="JvS" />}}
The '''invasion of Korriban''', also known as an '''assault on Korriban''', was an attempt by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to conquer [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]], around [[27,700 BBY]]. The Rakata fought with their [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-based technology but the [[Sith Empire (Pre-Republic)|Sith Empire]] ruled by [[Sith King|King]] [[Adas]], managed to defend themselves and rout the invaders. However [[King/Legends|King]] Adas was killed during the battle and his disappearance plunged Korriban into a bloody [[Korriban civil war|civil war]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Lore has it that Adas learned about Holocrons from Rakatan soldiers who attempted to conguer Sith space.|Tionne Solusar, ''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force''|<ref name="JvS" />}}
Around [[27,700 BBY]], the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] discovered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]]. At first, the aliens taught [[Sith King|King]] [[Adas]] how to record his essence into a device called a "[[Holocron/Legends|holocron]]," in an attempt to lull the Sith ruler into their confidence. Putting his newfound knowledge to use, Adas created [[Holocron of King Adas|his own holocron]],<ref name="END">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref> although the device became more a testament to his accomplishments than a teaching device.<ref name="TOTJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>

==The invasion==
{{Quote|Adas! Adas!|Adas's forces chanting their leader's name|<ref name="Hammer">{{InsiderCite|147|Hammer (short story)}}</ref>}}
[[File:SithKingAdas-BoSSFtDS.png|thumb|left|300px|Sith King Adas, the Sith'ari of ancient Sith]]
Eventually, though, the Rakata were more blatant in their actions and attempted to conquer the Sith,<ref name="END" /> using their [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-based technology.<ref name="TEA" /> Adas's forces gathered in a large army on the fields of Korriban to face the invading Rakata, who landed their ships as the king's soldiers chanted their leader's name.<ref name="Hammer">{{InsiderCite|147|Hammer (short story)}}</ref> The Sith were more than able to defend themselves, and Adas, refusing to tolerate their actions even in his advanced age, led his people in the vehement defense of Korriban. He participated in the punitive action, driving back the invaders with his massive ax<ref name="END" /> and killing dozens of Rakatan warriors.<ref name="Hammer" /> Around this time, a Sith named [[Yshaar Kael]] gained the title of "Betrayer of Adas" before being captured by the Rakata,<ref name="TOR:EV" /> and [[Raspir]], Adas's [[Sith sorcerer|court magician]], was also captured and placed in a [[mind prison]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> 

In the process, King Adas captured the Rakatan starships and turned them against the invaders. Adas's forces pushed on from Korriban, and reached [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], [[Malachor V]], and [[Tund/Legends|Tund]].<ref name="TEA" /> However, in securing what he hoped would be a future of freedom for his people, Adas perished.<ref name="END" />

==Aftermath==
{{Main|Korriban civil war}}
{{Main|Sith Empire expansion}}
{{Quote|The technology the Rakatan brought allowed the Sith to expand their influence and claim the planets that make up the dark fist of Sith Space.|Sorzus Syn, ''Book of Sith''|<ref name="BOS" />}}
[[File:Korriban-TOR.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Korriban's surface was devastated by the invasion]]
Without the stabilizing influence of Adas as king,<ref name="END" /> Korriban once again was plunged into<ref name="GH05" /> a bloody<ref name="GH07" /> [[Korriban civil war|civil war]],<ref name="GH05" /> with many claiming the title of ''[[Sith'ari/Legends|Sith'ari]]''.<ref name="END" /> Some of the Sith prophesied that a perfect being would one day arise and assume the position of ''Sith'ari'', although a number of the [[Kissai]] priests believed that Adas was the only true ''Sith'ari'' and that the prophecy had begun and ended with him.<ref name="BOS" /> As a result of the internal strife, the Sith capital was relocated to Ziost,<ref name="END" /> leaving behind their desolated homeworld<ref name="JvS" /> as a [[Burial/Legends|tombworld]] populated by [[Religion/Legends|religious]] fanatics.<ref name="TEA" /> Later, the successors to King Adas used captured Rakatan [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to [[Sith Empire expansion|expand]] their empire to the natural borders of their [[Sith Worlds/Legends|sector]],<ref name="BOS" /> including worlds such as [[Jaguada/Legends|Jaguada]],<ref name="TWW" /> and, to reach other worlds beyond the [[Stygian Caldera]], such as<ref name="BOS" /> Malachor V,<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="BOS" /> Tund,<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="BOS" /><ref name="TWW">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref> [[Thule/Legends|Thule]], and [[Arorua]].<ref name="BOS" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Exploration Corps/Legends|ExplorCorps]] member [[Malleus|Telloti Cillmam'n]] found the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Warb Null]] on [[Nicht Ka]], an [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]]-washed world located on the border of the ancient [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. After donning the armor, Cillmam'n was flooded with visions of the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] history, including the Rakatan invasion of Korriban.<ref name="Hammer" /> In [[38 ABY]], the Rakatan invasion of Korriban was mentioned in the [[Xenolinguist/Legends|xenolinguist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Milanda Vorgan]]'s article "[[The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic]]."<ref name="TWW" />
